spots.name: In Memory of Jim & Irma Mayfield
spots.blurb: You've reached In Memory of Jim & Irma Mayfield, a mural by Alfonso Garcia. A wall mural of two cowboys from the movie "Lonesome Dove" riding on horseback through the local canyons. One of them points down the street and says to the other, "I LOVE this town!".

spots.blurb: You've reached Greetings from Quitaque, a mural. A mural that says Quitaque Country Club at the top and Greetings from Quitaque in a postcard style format. The background behind the letters is local scenery with canyons and a horned lizard sits in the foreground.
